status: Additive prospective design limitation only; no implementation, control or workload executed.
documented_behavior: sys._getframe raises an auditing event named sys._getframe with the frame object as argument.
requirements: The proposed observer must invoke the original record_native_hook_result once before any observer frame access.
Audit-hook refusal during observer frame access is a diagnostic recording loss; it must not replace the original returned object or exception.
The diagnostic does not claim an unchanged complete audit-event sequence: the frame-inspection audit event is additional and occurs after the original operation.
A meaningful control must install a refusing audit hook in an isolated child and prove original outcome identity and incomplete observer admission without exposing frame locals.
Unknown historical failure cause, original source/runtime identity limits and existing workload/deadline constraints remain unchanged.
